about: Documented Word and Docs formatting shortcuts that OpenNote binds, as test input. Chords are in the canonical form (Ctrl+Shift+> is Ctrl+>, and a Mac Command key is Ctrl). Each row names its source. beats lists commands in wider scopes that this key takes over while the caret is in text; beatenBy lists commands in the text editor itself that apply first when they can.

notBound.why: Ctrl+0 resets the interface text size
Ctrl+Shift+T reopens a closed page tab
Ctrl+Shift+V pastes as plain text; pasting a format is Ctrl+Alt+Shift+V
Ctrl+Alt+V is dictation; pasting a format is Ctrl+Alt+Shift+V
